package contracts_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/contracts"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type audit struct {
	t *testing.T
}

func TestUnionStorage(t *testing.T) {
	endpoint := func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	_, err := svc.WrapFirstEndpoint(endpoint, audit{t})(context.Background(), &svc.FirstPayload{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = svc.WrapSecondEndpoint(endpoint, audit{t})(context.Background(), &svc.SecondPayload{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func (a audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	payload := info.Payload()
	payload.SetValue(nil)
	if info.Method() == "First" {
		require.Nil(a.t, payload.Value())
	} else {
		require.Equal(a.t, &svc.Choice{}, payload.Value())
	}
	payload.SetValue(&svc.Choice{})
	require.Equal(a.t, &svc.Choice{}, payload.Value())
	return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
}
